body: Promise-credibility forward test, Nov-2026 cohort (NOT a recommendation; not buy/sell). Kirloskar Brothers (KIRLOSBROS). Probability 0.37 (naive sector base rate 0.37) that: Kirloskar Brothers (KIRLOSBROS) FY27 standalone revenue growth >= 9.5% (double-digit less 0.5 pp tolerance). Probabilities set only by the pre-registered rule (research_notes/Promise tracker pilot/forward_test_2026-11/prereg.md s4): p0 = 0.366 (sector peers (Capital Goods), group 'revenue', n=71); N=1 < 3 so P_cred = P_base = 0.37. Evidence: call of 2026-08-03: "We remain confident of delivering double-digit revenue growth in FY27 over FY26 for our standalone business" (Q1 and Q2 FY27 opening remarks). Resolution: YES if FY27 standalone revenue from operations growth vs FY26 >= 9.5% (NSE XBRL standalone + screener standalone). Source: Q4FY27 results, press release / investor presentation and Q4FY27 earnings call transcript (NSE). Resolve by 2027-06-15; score Brier of P_cred vs P_base (prereg s5).

data.adjustment_applied: p0 = 0.366 (sector peers (Capital Goods), group 'revenue', n=71); N=1 < 3 so P_cred = P_base = 0.37
data.adjustment_rule: P_cred = clip(p0 + N/(N+20) x SAC, 0.05, 0.95); SAC = mean(y - p0(group)) over the company's resolved past promises (strict: delivered=1, else 0); N<3 -> P_cred = p0. P_base = p0.
data.base_rate_reasoning: Naive forecaster = leave-one-out strict delivery rate of Capital Goods peers in group 'revenue' (sector peers (Capital Goods), group 'revenue', n=71). No company-specific information.
data.promise_quote: "We remain confident of delivering double-digit revenue growth in FY27 over FY26 for our standalone business" (Q1 and Q2 FY27 opening remarks)
data.resolution_rule: YES if FY27 standalone revenue from operations growth vs FY26 >= 9.5% (NSE XBRL standalone + screener standalone).
data.resolution_source: Q4FY27 results, press release / investor presentation and Q4FY27 earnings call transcript (NSE)

title: Paper call: Kirloskar Brothers (KIRLOSBROS) FY27 standalone revenue growth >= 9.5% (double-digit less 0.5 pp tolerance)
